name: Fendara
description: Long-range scopes flagged Fendara for its black-hole signature, brighter than its mass allows. Old claim buoys tumble here, their registries expired and their owners gone. Claim jumpers whisper about a world that charts itself differently every survey.

stars.name: Grim Choir
stars.description: A stellar remnant of 41.82 solar masses, event horizon and unquiet. The accretion flow burns hotter than most stars while the center stays perfectly dark. Ephemeris updates track its slow variability across the decades.

planets.name: Gildedrock
planets.description: Temperate bands of green and gold suggest a biosphere in full swing. Rain follows the mountain ranges, and rivers braid the lowlands. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

moons.name: Hollow Basalt IV
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Kilnspire
planets.description: Dune seas bury everything but the oldest basalt spires. Water exists only as deep brine the drills have yet to reach. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

dwarfPlanets.name: Vapor Outer 39
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.
